fact: A training presentation hosted on the APDP site states that any transfer of personal data to a third State is subject to the APDP's prior authorisation and to a finding of equivalent protection under the Digital Code, with a Council of Ministers decree route for non-equivalent destinations.
title: Notions et principes fondamentaux de la protection des données personnelles : transfert de données personnelles (DPO et gestion des tiers intervenants)
